Giver: Right, so start here at the cross.
Follower: Okay, got the cross.
Giver: Now, head straight towards the haystack, but keep it on your left.
Follower: Left of the haystack? Got it.
Giver: Pass it close, then turn right towards the Carpenter.
Follower: Right of the Carpenter... okay.
Giver: Keep going straight past him, but don't go all the way to the Seven Beeches.
Follower: A bit short of the Beeches, left side... yeah.
Giver: Then swing right again, aiming for the Chapel, but stop before you hit it.
Follower: Left of the Chapel, coming up... okay.
Giver: Now turn right. You're heading towards the Reclaimed Fields.
Follower: Right of the fields... okay.
Giver: Keep going. You're going to pass the Crane Bay on your left.
Follower: Left of the Crane Bay... got it.
Giver: Good. Now turn right again. There's a big Vast Meadow, make sure you're on the right side of it.
Follower: Right of the meadow... okay.
Giver: Continue straight. Just past the meadow, you'll see the Attractive Cliffs on the left.
Follower: Left of the cliffs... okay.
Giver: Keep going straight now.
Follower: Okay, straight ahead.
Giver: Wait, hold on. Do you see the White-washed Cottage?
Follower: Yeah, I see that little house up ahead.
Giver: Ignore it, keep going straight. You need to get past it to the right.
Follower: Okay, ignoring the house, heading towards the coast...
Giver: Right, you're heading for the Moored Boats now.
Follower: Okay, looking for the boats... I see them!
Giver: Good. Once you pass the boats, turn left and head down towards the bottom edge of the map.
Follower: Left of the boats... okay, heading down.
Giver: Watch out, there's a Crashed Spaceship over to the left side, make sure you don't go there.
Follower: Okay, avoiding the spaceship, staying on the right...
Giver: Keep going straight until you hit the edge.
Follower: Okay, straight down... almost at the bottom.
Giver: Now turn right. There's a Chestnut Tree there, make sure you end up on the right side of it.
Follower: Right of the chestnut tree... oh, I see it, but it's not where I expected it to be.
Giver: That's fine, just follow my line. You end up at the Finish cross.
Follower: Okay, I'm drawing a line to the Finish... done.
Giver: Perfect.
Follower: Done.
